MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 17

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

10. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 6
   C. 17
   D. 12

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 28

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

16. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
